card.name: The word central before nervous system
card.fires_on: The word "central" (or "Central") just before "nervous system (CNS)" in drug-interaction and warning text. It also fires weakly on "other" after a drug list.

modes.label: Central before nervous system
modes.description: The word central begins the phrase central nervous system, often in CNS depressant or CNS pathology wording.
modes.example: use is not recommended if a woman is concurrently using<< central>> nervous system (CNS) depressants

modes.label: Other in a list of related drugs
modes.description: The word other follows a named drug in a hypersensitivity list, leading into a drug class name.
